workshoptitle: Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) on OCI - Beginner

tutorials.title: Luna OLVM Administration - Training
tutorials.description: Complete a separate Luna session covering OLVM deployment, migration, backup, monitoring, snapshots, and users and roles. Allow 6-8 hours; requires the direct Luna lab link.

tutorials.title: OLVM Administration - Quiz
tutorials.description: Use alongside Luna OLVM Administration: 100 scored OLVM questions, ten per task, with discussion explanations and an 80% passing score.

tutorials.title: OLVM Administration - Self-Study Quiz Bank
tutorials.description: Separate 500-question study bank across seven weighted objective areas, with explanations, module badges, and a 38-subtopic coverage guide.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Troubleshooting resources and directions for getting assistance during the workshop.
